content:
The image shows a mango leaf with several dark, irregular necrotic spots scattered across the blade. The spots are dark brown to black, roughly circular to irregular in shape, with no white powdery coating (ruling out Powdery Mildew), no sooty black superficial film (ruling out Sooty Mould), and no evidence of shoot/branch dieback (ruling out Die Back). The discrete, dark lesions with defined margins on the leaf surface are characteristic of Anthracnose caused by *Colletotrichum gloeosporioides*.
